summary: Fairer end-of-hour music: lookahead plans up to four consecutive music slots by effective rotation weight; non-music pairing, direct inserts, requests and hour termination unchanged. Remote DJ: a failed session is muted at once and cleaned up off its callback thread by one bounded worker; only successful cleanup frees the slot; failure quarantines Remote DJ until an engine restart (never automatic). No migration, static, unit, package or protected-runtime change; restart Gunicorn and engine.
